product.description: flexible LED strip 8 mm wide - Seoul Semiconductor mid-power LEDs, 140 per metre - warm white 3000 K - CRI 95 - 24 V - 5 m reel; laid in a case's lamp rail or canopy behind its baffle
product.codeBasis: the maker's article number of the 3000 K CRI 95 reel
product.makerClaim: recommended by the maker for exhibition construction, furniture lighting and luminaire construction

light.beamName: bare strip without optic: each LED emits into the half space, near Lambertian

electrical.control: constant-voltage 24 V supply, dimmable; the dimming method is not named by the maker

housing.mounting: self-adhesive, laid in the case's lamp rail or behind its canopy baffle, outside the sealed case volume

photometricFile.note: The maker publishes no LDT or IES file for a bare strip; a bare strip is a line of near-Lambertian emitters.

sources.title: Lumistrips, LumiFlex1095 Seoul LED Strip warm white CRI95 3000K 3600lm 24V 42 LEDs/ft 16.4ft reel (article 38672)

unverified: The strip's ultraviolet and infrared content: a white LED of phosphor-converted blue emits none below 400 nm by construction, but the maker states no spectrum.
The cutting interval of 50 mm decides how closely a length can follow a drawn run; it is not recorded as a field.
Its R9 and TM-30 values are not published.
